protocol.availability: Scorecard known_at, the saved daily report check time. Require known_at < frozen_at.
protocol.binary_baseline: A constant-rate prediction for each game, set before freeze from the per-league expanding rate with one prior count per outcome.
protocol.verdict_rule: A verdict requires at least 30 comparable games, counting only games with a fitted temperature toward the 1X2 minimum. A smaller sample or an unavailable interval yields `inconclusive (n too small)`. A strictly positive lower 95% bound on mean log-loss improvement yields `skill_over_baseline` for goal markets and `supports recalibration` for 1X2. A lower bound at or below zero yields `no_skill_over_baseline` for goal markets and `does not support recalibration` for 1X2.
protocol.multiple_comparisons: The three verdicts use the same 159-game cohort without any adjustment for multiple comparisons, so a borderline confidence interval (for example, a lower bound within 0.005 of zero) is weak evidence at most.

one_x_two.reliability_scope: Reliability bins and logistic slopes are descriptive only for the original frozen forecasts.

temperature.walk_forward_limitation: Walk-forward temperature fitting could not run at all. 0 of 159 games had at least 30 earlier finals known before freeze because the football ledger has no per-game result times. No temperature was applied, and no calibration conclusion is possible yet. Reliability bins and logistic slopes are descriptive only for the original frozen forecasts.

reliability.scope: Descriptive ten-bin expected calibration error on original frozen probabilities; not a calibration fit, significance test or evidence of future success.
